why_best: A structured, top-to-bottom editorial cadence ensures the broadcast audience absorbs the pricing breakdown before reaching the final commitment callout.
why_bad: A chaotic or flashy reveal would erode viewer trust and make the financial information feel deceptive or hard to scan.
trap: Failing to align the visual weight of the final total with the primary action button will cause the viewer's eye to linger endlessly in the mid-section.
